# awesome-mcp-servers

> A curated catalog of working MCP servers for Claude Desktop and other clients, labelled with publisher, execution environment, and mutation capabilities.

The project is a maintained list of verified MCP servers, categorized by function such as web search, databases, and operations. Entries are filtered for reliability and honesty, with labels indicating if a server is official, community-made, read-only, or mutating. It serves as a companion to other AI coding agent resources.

## Docs

- [awesome-mcp-servers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/main/README.md): A catalog of verified MCP servers, labelled by publisher, runtime, permissions, and licensing status.
- [Why this list exists](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#why-this-list-exists): Inclusion criteria for real, working, honest MCP servers, plus rejection rules and weekly maintenance verification processes.
- [Legend](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#legend): Definitions for publisher, mutation, location, and cost labels used to categorize every entry in the server catalog.
- [Reference servers (MCP steering group)](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#reference-servers-mcp-steering-group): Official reference implementations from the MCP steering group, including filesystem, git, memory, and sequential thinking servers.
- [Files, Filesystem & Local Data](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#files-filesystem--local-data): Community server for reading, searching, editing, and deleting notes in an Obsidian vault via the Local REST API.
- [Web Search & Browsing](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#web-search--browsing): Servers for web search and browsing, including Brave, DuckDuckGo, Exa, and Context7 documentation retrieval.
- [Browser Automation](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#browser-automation): Servers for browser automation and control, including Browser Use, Chrome DevTools, and Playwright.
- [Source Control](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#source-control): Servers for source control management, including Gitea, GitHub, and GitLab repository and issue tools.
- [Issue Trackers & Project Management](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#issue-trackers--project-management): Servers for issue tracking and project management, including Asana, Atlassian, Linear, Orbit, and Trello.
- [Communication](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#communication): Servers for communication and social media, including Autoposting, BulkPublish, Discord, and Google Workspace.
- [Relational Databases](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#relational-databases): ClickHouse, MySQL, Postgres, and Supabase servers with read-only defaults, write flags, and hosted endpoints.
- [NoSQL & Document Databases](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#nosql--document-databases): MongoDB and Neo4j official servers for local and hosted use, with read-only modes and OAuth options.
- [Vector & Memory Stores](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#vector--memory-stores): Persistent agent memory, ChromaDB vector search, and a shared index of known software failures.
- [Productivity & Notes](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#productivity--notes): Airtable, Apple Notes, Google Calendar, Notion, and Process Street servers for data, notes, and workflows.
- [Design & Creative](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#design--creative): Cadre video editing, Figma design tools, Blender 3D control, and Orkas video studio for creative tasks.
- [Operations & Infrastructure](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#operations--infrastructure): AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, and Datadog official servers for cloud infrastructure, APIs, and monitoring.
- [AI & ML Platforms](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#ai--ml-platforms): Gateways and hosted servers for accessing third-party apps, APIs, and generative AI models.
- [Specialised / Vertical](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#specialised--vertical): Hosted servers for health records, financial market data, CRM management, and official statistics.
- [Frameworks & SDKs for Building MCP Servers](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#frameworks--sdks-for-building-mcp-servers): Official and community Python, Go, and TypeScript SDKs for building MCP servers and clients.
- [Discovery hubs](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#discovery-hubs): Reference repositories, community lists, and hosted registries for discovering new MCP servers.
- [Related work](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#related-work): Curated lists of AI coding agents, local AI tools, and privacy-focused AI architectures.
